capabilities: : Insert single line break on Shift + Enter
: Detect special contexts (lists, tasks, tables, code blocks)
intentEvidence: I created this plugin to make it easier to create paragraphs while typing.
motivation: I like to write in stories and was used to hitting the enter key once to create a new paragraph. I refused to change my habits, so I created this plugin to make it easier to create paragraphs while typing.
problem: Users who are accustomed to using a single Enter keypress to create a new paragraph find the default behavior of inserting only a single line break inconvenient.
summary: Automatically inserts a double newline when the Enter key is pressed, allowing users to create paragraphs using a single keypress.
